subject: Action required: onboarding packet + PO number mismatch (Halcyon Tech)
content:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@halcyontech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Action required: onboarding packet + PO number mismatch (Halcyon Tech)

Hi Laura —

Thanks for your patience during onboarding. We started the PO issuance with Procurement yesterday but ran into two items we need to reconcile before we can finalize activation:

1) The PO number we received from your side (PO-HT-45812) appears to be a vendor-side reference. Our finance team needs an inbound PO issued to Redwood format so it can be routed through our ledger.

2) Spend cap / line items: Procurement issued a provisional PO but the line-item granularity got consolidated on their export, which changed the spend buckets. That resulted in a mismatch against the spend cap listed in the onboarding form.

Could you: 1) attach the completed onboarding form (PDF) and 2) confirm whether your finance team expects the consolidated line or the original itemized SKU lines? If you can attach the vendor PO copy as well, that will speed reconciliation.

I'll loop our procurement PM (Karthik) and onboarding ops (Monica) to propose a short remediation plan.

Best,
Naomi Feldman\Vendor Onboarding Lead\Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: (requested) vendor_onboarding_packet_request.docx (stub)

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@halcyontech.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Halcyon Procurement <procurement@halcyontech.com>, Finance Ops <ap@halcyontech.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Action required: onboarding packet + PO number mismatch (Halcyon Tech)

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for flagging. Attached is our completed onboarding form and a copy of the PO our finance system generated (vendor reference PO-HT-45812). A few notes:

- Our AP team consolidated three SKU lines into a single billing line for ease of processing — that appears to be why your provisional PO shows different line detail.
- When we confirmed terms, the agreed total cap was $300,000 for the first 12 months; I see your provisional PO has a cap of $250,000. That may be an internal quota issue on your side.
- We can split the consolidated line back into itemized SKUs if Redwood requires it — just confirm the internal SKU mapping you expect.

Attaching: completed_onboarding_form.pdf; vendor_po_copy.pdf

Apologies for the back-and-forth. Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Regards,
Laura Chen\Sr. Procurement Manager\Halcyon Technologies

---
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Action required: onboarding packet + PO number mismatch (Halcyon Tech)

Thanks Laura — and thanks Naomi for the ping. Quick proposal to resolve before escalation to Finance:

Action plan (3 steps, aim to complete within 3 business days):
- Step 1: Naomi / onboarding team will provide a suggested SKU->line mapping that matches the vendor's consolidated line to our internal ledger buckets. (I attached a working CSV with the proposed mapping.)
- Step 2: Halcyon confirms they can accept the remap for initial invoicing (vendor keeps PO-HT-45812 as a reference).
- Step 3: Karthik (Procurement) to issue a corrected Redwood-format PO (provisional) that sets the spend cap to the agreed $300,000 or to the confirmed final amount after both parties sign off. The corrected PO should preserve both the vendor reference and our internal line items.

Open questions:
- Which number should appear in the "external_reference" field (vendor ref PO-HT-45812 or the new RI PO)?
- Do we need DocuSign sign-off to bump the spend cap from $250k to $300k, or is internal approval enough?

Attachments: lineitem_remap.csv (working)

Thanks — Monica\\nOnboarding Operations\Redwood Inference

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@halcyontech.com>
Cc: Halcyon Procurement <procurement@halcyontech.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Action required: onboarding packet + PO number mismatch (Halcyon Tech)

Hi all —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. We completed procurement review and issued a corrected provisional PO in our system to align with the vendor's agreed total. Summary below: 

- New Redwood provisional PO: RI-2026-00291 (please reference vendor PO-HT-45812 in the external_reference field).
- Spend cap set to: $300,000 (per vendor confirmation).
- Line items: we preserved the vendor-consolidated billing line but added a ledger-level mapping so Redwood internal reporting can break out costs across three internal SKUs (mapping attached and reflected in the revised PO).
- DocuSign: Not required for this cap adjustment — Procurement approval workflow (manager sign-off completed). If Finance needs a signed amendment, we can route a DocuSign.

Attachments included: revised_po_RI-2026-00291.pdf, updated_onboarding_packet.pdf (includes ledger mapping and the external_reference field set).

Next steps (for Naomi / Onboarding):
- Naomi: please update the vendor record with the RI PO and the mapping so activation can proceed.
- Laura / Halcyon: confirm when you submit your first invoice against PO-HT-45812 / RI-2026-00291 so AP can link it.

Karthik Iyer\Procurement PM\Redwood Inference

---

Summary (thread status):
- onboarding form: completed (attached)
- vendor reference PO: PO-HT-45812 (vendor)
- Redwood provisional PO: RI-2026-00291 (issued; spend cap $300,000)
- Line-item mapping: agreed; remap included in revised PO
- No DocuSign required at this time

Attachments in thread: completed_onboarding_form.pdf; vendor_po_copy.pdf; lineitem_remap.csv; revised_po_RI-2026-00291.pdf; updated_onboarding_packet.pdf
